bookingOpens: Online on Zenchef through the restaurant's website. A booking only stands once the confirmation email or text arrives; if none comes, contact the restaurant.
cancellation: A card guarantee is taken but nothing is charged. Bookings can be changed or cancelled up to 12 hours before; later requests are handled case by case. The terms set a €500 per person penalty for a no-show without cancelling in time.
